hack.root_cause: Compromised Admin Account — Unauthorized Token Minting
hack.description: An attacker reactivated a 180-day-dormant Gala Games MINTER account to mint 5 billion GALA tokens (nominally $216M), sold 592 million for $21.8M in ETH before Gala's own blocklist function halted further sales — with all funds mysteriously returned the next day.
